name: School: Second Period
description: One roll in each room. Not rolling is free.

checks.name: Learn what lives in the drains

outcomes.criticalSuccess: As success, and they know a centipede's weak spot: its nerve. A show of force sends one running (Will +2).
outcomes.success: Giant centipedes: they climb, they nest, the bite is venomous. Tonight, they've already made the Recall Knowledge check.
outcomes.failure: They knock a jar over, and tidying up takes the rest of the period.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They break a jar and stay late to help clean up: Fatigued tonight.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: They qualify, and the range officer remembers their name. +1 circumstance on their first ranged Strike tonight.
outcomes.success: They qualify: +1 circumstance on their first ranged Strike tonight.
outcomes.failure: Not today. Nothing lost; they can come back.
outcomes.criticalFailure: A breach of range drill. They stay to strip and clean every rifle on the rack: Fatigued tonight.

notes: Both pay off in Flood Tunnel Clearance.
